<notes>
revised -> harness.py code extraction and execution mechanism -> All three base rollouts diverge (91 vs 90 vs 98) on the same deterministic computation. All six candidates (inv1-inv3, dom1-dom3) are identical and all extracted Python code blocks via regex and executed them with tools.python(); the [python] output sections in each candidate rollout show deterministic execution yielding 91^14 = 2670419511272061205254504361 with sum = 91. This traces directly to the divergence moment in base1-base3: the harness returned LLM text assertion without executing the code. Library precedent (holdout-numeric-002 and holdout-numeric-005) documents identical pattern (deterministic computation diverging under LLM assertion) solved by adding regex extraction of ```python code blocks with tools.python() execution and text fallback.

revised -> prompts/task.md instruction to generate Python code -> Base rollouts had no instruction and showed no code blocks in LLM responses; LLM attempted mental arithmetic and diverged. All six candidates with the instruction "Solve this by writing and executing Python code. Show the code and provide the final numeric answer." show LLM generating ```python code blocks in their trajectories. Library holdout-numeric-005 explicitly documents that instruction and extraction are a necessary pair: candidates inv2/inv3/agg1 that added extraction without the instruction fell back to manual reasoning; candidates dom3/agg2/agg3 that included both extraction and instruction executed code deterministically. The instruction is the trigger that changes the LLM's response format to be compatible with the extraction mechanism.

kept -> prompts/system.md "You are a helpful assistant." -> Base harness and all candidates kept this unchanged; no trajectory moment motivates modification.
</notes>

ADOPT: inv1

=== FILE: harness.py ===
"""Harness for numeric computation: executes Python code when available, falls back to text extraction."""

import re


def solve(question, llm, tools, files):
    system = files.get("prompts/system.md", "")
    prompt = files["prompts/task.md"].replace("{question}", question)
    reply = llm(prompt, system=system)
    
    # Extract and execute Python code blocks from the LLM response
    python_blocks = re.findall(r'```python\n(.*?)\n```', reply, re.DOTALL)
    
    if python_blocks:
        # Execute the first Python code block found
        code = python_blocks[0]
        execution_result = tools.python(code)
        
        # Return the last non-empty line from the execution output
        lines = [line.strip() for line in execution_result.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if lines:
            return lines[-1]
    
    # Fallback: return the last non-empty line from the LLM's response
    lines = [line for line in reply.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    return lines[-1] if lines else ""

=== FILE: prompts/task.md ===
{question}

Solve this by writing and executing Python code. Show the code and provide the final numeric answer.
